name: cs-content
description: The marketplace for the AI Content Team OS plugin.

plugins.name: ai-content-team-os
plugins.description: One command that asks how today's Reel gets made - cut the clips you filmed in Higgsfield, or render an AI avatar video in HeyGen Studio - then mines your Instagram comments for ideas, learns your voice from your real posts, researches the day, and publishes one artifact of nine ready-to-post options: three Instagram with the Reel, three LinkedIn, three X, each scored. Click POST, say "post", and Claude drives your Chrome to publish it. Runs only when you run it; never on a schedule.
